boundaries: This is an archive/native-reference inspection, not independent execution of source tests.
Git tree correspondence, hosted conclusions, provider identity and repository controls are separate.
Only declared build artifact references are rehashed; source/tool hashes outside these ZIPs are not.
Passing rejection/residual/unsupported regression cases do not certify their outputs or institutional approval.

blind_corpus.scope: Bounded managed-identity projection and explicit authored residual failures

configuration_corpus.scope: Bounded legacy options, bibliography resources, declaration content and logo rejection

contract_adapter_corpus.scope: 18 canonical configuration fixtures plus three local rendering/precedence controls

image_corpus.scope: Bounded PNG/JPEG/SVG, native path and byte inputs across four profiles

layout_order_corpus.scope: Bounded section order, logical pagination, native destinations and A4/30mm geometry

native_evidence_corpus.scope: Fixed-expression synthetic semantics and source/output-bound inventories; not full replay or thesis acceptance

navigation_corpus.scope: Bounded synthetic contents, bookmarks, links, appendix content and page labels

optional_corpus.scope: Bounded public optional sections, typed/private-log rejections and authored residual controls

rendered_corpus.scope: Bounded synthetic declaration, table, footnote and appendix-reference text

terms_corpus.scope: Bounded abbreviation/glossary/index values, actual references and unsupported-extraction diagnostics

inspection_summary.watchdog_scope: Observation files and declared logs verified; unittest job determines pass/fail.

limitations: Names, addresses, clinical narratives and re-identification risk are not covered by this baseline.
Only selected Git text blobs are scanned; images, binary documents, LFS payloads and submodule contents are not scanned.
Repository checks do not inspect application runtime data or prevent upload before CI executes.
Detection is probabilistic; no findings is not a declaration that data is anonymous or safe to publish.
